description: The only way to give this round's conclusion on a long command. Fill the fields and call it; the platform adds the command facts and stores the answer. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.conclusion: normal (it looks fine: write your note with record_note first), adviser (abnormal: the platform stops the command and tells the responsible adviser) or human (a person should look: the platform tells the person and does not stop the command).
parameters.nextReviewInMs: Only when conclusion is normal: how long until the next look, in milliseconds (a positive integer).
parameters.reason: One plain sentence for the adviser or the person; not empty.
